modern: Just as it is with the limbs in bodies which are united into one, so it is with rational beings which exist separately, for they have been made for one shared work. And you will see this more clearly if you often say to yourself that I am a member of the system of rational beings. But if, using the letter r, you say that you are a part, you do not yet love men from your heart; doing good does not yet delight you for its own sake; you still do it merely as a matter of propriety, and not yet as doing good to yourself.
original: Just as it is with the members in those bodies which are united in one, so it is with rational beings which exist separate, for they have been constituted for one co-operation. And the perception of this will be more apparent to thee if thou often sayest to thyself that I am a member of the system of rational beings. But if [using the letter r] thou sayest that thou art a part, thou dost not yet love men from thy heart; beneficence does not yet delight thee for its own sake; thou still doest it barely as a thing of propriety, and not yet as doing good to thyself.
